title: Drop LORE_SOURCE_REF and the source-build fallback from lore-check.yml once lore 0.15.0 is on npm; fix the :66-72 header (paired with lore-cli LCLI-781)
description: Quest-side half of the cleanup paired with lore-cli LCLI-781. The DEC-169 source fallback in .github/workflows/lore-check.yml (LORE_SOURCE_REF, currently eb13ece3ffa6ed2c3ad17362476e7045eecfafa1, lore-cli dev squash of #702, set by QCLI-550) exists only because lore 0.15.0 was not on npm when the pair was cut; its own comment says it is TEMPORARY and a follow-up PR drops it so the npm install is again the only path. Once lore 0.15.0 is on npm latest: remove the LORE_SOURCE_REF variable, the source-build steps and the assertion branch that exists for them, keeping the version assertion for the npm path, and fix the stale header at lines ~66-72 ("With 0.13.0 published the npm pin is again the only path"), which contradicts the env comment (QCLI-550 reviewer finding, deliberately deferred). This is a CI workflow change, so it needs floor and an Opus review. scripts/lore-pin-staleness.mjs reads the literal npm pin and must keep matching. Not startable before lore 0.15.0 is on npm; do not pre-empt it.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore 0.15.0 is on npm latest, read from the registry, before this change lands
lore-check.yml has no LORE_SOURCE_REF and no source-build fallback step, the npm install of the pinned lore is the only path, and the version assertion still fails on a mismatch
The header at lines ~66-72 and the DEC-169 comment agree with what the workflow now does
lore check is green on the PR and scripts/lore-pin-staleness.mjs still reads the pin; test/qcli358-lore-pin-staleness.test.ts and test/qcli535-dec240-ci-hardening.test.ts pass
